graphEvents.label: No CI path executes spec-tree tests

label: All 111 spec-tree test files are captured or archived artifacts: 91 under scratch, context, baseline or logs, and 20 archived packet tests, fixture seeds, stress scripts and one-time rewrite script tests.
No CI path runs any spec-tree test: run-node-tests excludes the spec tree wholesale and no workflow run step executes a file under specs.
Deleting the spec-tree test files saves zero CI minutes; their cost is an inflated census, and the live corpus is about 1159 files rather than 1270.
Four Python tests under the sk-git commit-standards packet cover one-time history-rewrite scripts, so they say nothing about any runtime under test.

activation-matrix.test.mjs and guardrail-negative-controls.test.mjs in the hook-injection packet are the only files with those names in the tree, so guardrail activation behaviour is tested only in a folder CI never runs.

direction: Deleting spec-tree test files to save run time
reason: No CI path executes them, so the saving is zero minutes and the real gain is census accuracy.
